sections.heading: Furniture for tall people
lines: Desk risers or a sit-stand desk
Hips level with or above your knees

sections.heading: Back to uni
lines: Laptop on a few books, separate keyboard
Long walks: both straps, pack light

sections.heading: Jammed finger in ball sports
lines: Wrapped cold pack about 15 min, hand raised
Buddy tape to the next finger, snug not tight

sections.heading: Wrist after a fall
lines: Take rings off early, before swelling
Avoid leaning or lifting on it for now

sections.heading: Doorway chest stretch
lines: Forearms on the frame, gentle step forward
Hold about 30 sec, a few times a day

sections.heading: Evening back stiffness
lines: Lying on your back, knee rocks × 10

caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Jan 25–30.

Tall? Desk risers or a sit-stand desk can help keep your hips level with or above your knees. A jammed finger usually starts with a wrapped cold pack for about 15 minutes and the hand raised. After a fall onto your hand, take rings off early, before swelling. Stiff back in the evening? Try knee rocks × 10, then cat-cow × 8.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Pain spreading to a limb, or numbness, is worth an assessment. Book online via the link in bio
